description: Returns a company's Trustpilot profile and reviews as JSON. `company` is the reviewed domain (e.g. `www.nike.com`). The response has a `company` summary (`trustScore`, `totalReviews`, `ratingDistribution` 1-5, `categories`, `contact`) and a `reviews` array - each with `rating`, `title`, `text`, `verified`, `author` (name, country, review count), `reply` (the company's response) and dates. Page with `page`/`pages` (20 reviews per page), and filter with `stars`, `sort` (recency/relevancy), `language`, `date`, `search`, `verified` or `replies`. Returns JSON. Billed like an API request; listing plugins bill one unit per result page they fetch, so keep max_results modest.

company.description: The reviewed company's domain, e.g. 'www.nike.com' or 'nike.com'. A full site URL or a pasted Trustpilot review URL is also accepted.

date.description: Only reviews from a recent window: last30days, last3months, last6months, last12months. Omit for all time.

language.description: Review language ISO-2 code (e.g. 'en', 'de') or 'all'. Default 'all'. Default: all.

page.description: 1-based page to start from (20 reviews/page). Default: 1.

pages.description: How many consecutive pages to fetch from `page` onward (20 reviews each). Stops early at the last page. Default: 1.

proxy_country.description: Proxy country the request is sent from (ISO-2, e.g. 'US', 'DE'). Defaults to a country chosen for the site.

replies.description: Only reviews the company has replied to. Default: false.

search.description: Keyword to search within the company's reviews.

sort.description: Ordering: recency, relevancy. Default 'recency' (newest first). Default: recency.

stars.description: Only reviews with these star ratings (1, 2, 3, 4, 5). Repeatable, e.g. stars=4&stars=5.

verified.description: Only verified reviews (Trustpilot's verified badge). Default: false.

name: trustpilot_reviews
title: Scrape Trustpilot company reviews
